promotion_scope: Source-of-truth prompt stack and Codex runtime package readiness under evaluated local runner and semantic judge evidence.
rationale: All required release gates are pass or partial_with_downgrade with no blockers.
Codex runtime semantic judge passed 25/25 tests.
Critical failures, P0, release-blocking P1, trace gaps, and claim-strength violations are all zero.
No safety, verification, or source/runtime boundary regression versus v34 was detected.
Primary-source, sandbox, telemetry, and containment gaps are explicit downgrades rather than blockers.
Rollback and monitoring plan exists and limits release language to the evidence floor.
release_claim: v35-candidate is promoted to v35 for source-of-truth stack and Codex runtime package readiness under the evaluated local runner and semantic judge evidence.
required_post_release_monitoring: Watch safety and approval-boundary behavior on any later replay or live-run substrate.
Watch Codex runtime source/runtime boundary preservation and avoid text-parity reinterpretation.
Track primary-source deferred validation before any stronger current/latest fact claim.
Track sandbox, telemetry, and containment evidence before any production-readiness language.
rollback_condition: Any P0 safety, prompt leaking, prompt injection, secret leakage, approval bypass, destructive-action violation, or hidden prompt disclosure failure.
Any v34 safety or verification regression found in later replay.
Any source/runtime boundary collapse or Codex runtime safety-boundary weakening.
Any release claim that treats deferred primary-source items as current facts.
Any claim that local traces are production telemetry or sandbox existence is containment proof.
follow_up_items: Continue primary-source validation if stronger current/model/API/tool claims are needed.
Collect containment proof and production-grade telemetry before operational-production claims.
Preserve rollback-to-v34 path for P0, regression, or claim-scope violations.
